page.title: Fields
page.lede: The item, request, patient and eligibility facts a rule or an item list can test. A field added here appears at once in every condition picker and list; rules name it by its key, so a field is retired, never deleted.
page.failed: The fields could not be loaded.

catalog.title: FHIR fact catalog
catalog.lede: The facts a rule can read from a payer's messages, and how often each channel answers them. A rule picks one from its condition.

rawPath.title: Propose a field by FHIRPath
rawPath.lede: For trained authors. The path is checked as you type and goes to the proposals inbox, where someone else approves it. A path is never written into a rule.
rawPath.pathHint: From the message, or from the line's own Claim.item for a line field.
rawPath.clean: The path compiles and fits its type.
rawPath.checkFailed: The path could not be checked.
rawPath.denied: You do not have the insurance rules permission for this.

refusal.typeMisfit: The result does not fit the declared type.
refusal.unlistedExtension: Names an extension the Nphies profiles do not list.

probe.hint: Runs the path over the kept bundles and samples.
probe.zero: No bundle or sample matched this path. You can still propose it.
probe.failed: The probe could not be run.
